title: Castle Kidnapped
content: I painted this bizarre scene in 1989 for the cover of "Castle Kidnapped" by John DeChancie. My friendJames Warholaposed for the guy with the fizzy wine glass, and I posed as the jester with the levitatingmarotte.I enjoyed the creature design on this one, especially figuring out the walk cycle of a 6-legged blue ankylo-tortoise. I hope that little orange eyeball frog hops away before he gets stepped on.Get the original book on AmazonPreviously on GJ:Gradations
